prompts.guided:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create realistic, production-quality Chinese desktop web-app UI with clear hierarchy, strong typography, intentional imagery and purposeful spacing. Design a focused primary screen for 海客科技's 海客视频, a local visual AI video production application. Target dimensions exactly 1440 x 1024, one screen, no browser chrome, no device bezel, no presentation frame.
Current date anchor: 2026-10-13 Asia/Shanghai; any visible dates must be plausible relative to this date. Small unobtrusive text at top right "设计稿 · 示例数据" so this is clearly proposed design.
Reference roles: image 1 user's current audio-page screenshot; image 2 captured live audio page; image 3 captured live project page; image 4 official transparent HAIKE 海客科技 company logo; image 5 actual project's template3 video frame with virtual woman host. Existing UI references establish brand and shared navigation, not information density. Use exact supplied company logo artwork without redrawing or changing its shape, colors or proportions. Use template3 frame as the actual video preview or thumbnail, keeping its 3:4 aspect ratio and woman host.
Preserve brand: primary orange #F64B00 with black text on primary buttons, yellow #FFDC00 for subtle steps and pale yellow #FFF7C1 active navigation, body #191919, secondary #666666, white content, #F7F7F5 background, light #DFDFD9 dividers; clean Chinese system sans-serif similar PingFang SC. Body 14–16px, page title 28–32px, generous whitespace. Use 8px controls, 12px modest panel corners, no glossy shadows.
HARD CONSTRAINT: a shared fixed 242px left sidebar, SAME structure and geometry in every concept. Logo at top followed by "HAIKE VIDEO", "海客视频", "项目、素材与审核制作工具". Navigation in exact sequence: group "项目", items "项目库", "作品管理"; group "通用工具", items "配音中心", "自动生产中心", "已发布成片索引", "素材库", "素材解说". Use small simple Lucide outline icons, 项目库 is active pale yellow with 3px orange left edge. Do NOT change global menu labels or add menus. A low-key bottom sidebar account item can show "创作账户" and "账户中心".
Primary journey is digital-human explainer production: edit Chinese script, pick template3, choose presenter and voice by sight and audition, confirm fees before paid submission, follow real stages, review/download completed version. Hide raw engine/model IDs, supplier keys and server workflow parameters in a collapsed "高级设置". Voice selection should show friendly name, short scene tag, availability, cached "试听" vs paid "生成新试听" with price confirmation. Actual selectable example "海客验收音色", "中文 · 自然讲解", speed "1.0×". Other unavailable voices should be secondary or omitted, not fake available.
Use actual example script: "海客科技，让创作更简单。一个接口，连接配音、数字人和创作工作流。" Template label "数字人口播模板3", aspect "3:4". This frame is a configuration/design view, not a fake completed live generation. Any rendered preview must say "版式示意". Do not invent a confirmed digital-human price: use "生成前确认费用" or "待报价", no numerical video price. Do not show all models working via one Key as already implemented.
Product screen not a feature inventory: one clear primary action and at most two supporting areas. Prefer spacing/grouping/typography, then dividers, subtle surface tints, borders only if needed, shadows last. Do not center whole app inside a card. Do not nest cards inside cards. No marketing hero, charts, vanity metrics, huge settings grid, fake waveform or unnecessary tabs. No code, secrets, technical IDs, or repeated full explanatory paragraphs. Nothing clipped. All visible interaction labels readable in Chinese.
Direction name (internal only, do not put this name or option numbers on the image): 引导式制作.
Structure: production wizard for first-time commercial users, current step choosing host and sound. Page header breadcrumb "项目库 / 海客科技介绍" then title "制作数字人口播" and restrained secondary "保存草稿". Below, one slim horizontal stepper: "文案" → "模板" → "人物与声音" → "费用确认" → "预览下载", third active orange, first two completed.
Main left working region approx 560px: heading "选一位出镜人物，配上合适的声音". Single selected human portrait with supplied virtual woman (derive a natural crop from reference), caption "海客虚拟主持人", subtle "更换人物" action. Use calm divider then compact voice row "海客验收音色", "中文 · 自然讲解", native-style small play "试听" (cached existing audio) and "更换音色"; one "语速" control with 1.0× centered and light slower/faster labels. Below a closed "高级设置" row. Do not fill with extra objects.
Main right approx 370px preview area, heading "模板3 · 版式示意", show complete actual reference template3 frame scaled proportionally, height around 475px, not cropped. Short below "画幅 3:4 · 字幕开启".
Bottom persistent footer within content area: secondary "上一步", middle quiet "生成前确认费用", strong orange primary "下一步：确认费用". This should feel very approachable and spacious; people and listening first, no large admin forms.

Do NOT replace it with a full-screen portrait, beige background, marketing cover, or a large host above captions. The woman portrait outside the preview may be cropped for avatar selection, but the VIDEO preview itself must preserve actual template3 layout. Sidebar artwork and menu geometry must match the other references.
